scope: Provider callbacks and bridged tasks, a flapping readiness probe, and the five pinned Go providers unchanged through the public lifecycle (install with their own activation recipes, catalog cell, a provider-reached call, validation, teardown), with no agent descendants and no orphaned shims. The 35 lifecycle scenarios are rerun.

realProviders.isolation: loopback port, sandbox HOME and recording shims, isolated user bus (preflight: bus-isolation.log), dead egress proxy

goOutcomes.hostos: public install refused: the manifest declares no recipe
goOutcomes.ollama: installed and called; teardown refused by plan validation (set_host_service_state requires uri); stays active
goOutcomes.cloudflare: installed, called, torn down; validation reaches the provider and reports its error
goOutcomes.tailscale: installed, called against the recording Incus inventory (container:local:worker-01), torn down; validation reaches the provider and reports its error
goOutcomes.k3s.restart: installed and called, agent restarted with the provider still running: generation, catalog and connection restored, called again, torn down

goTransientsSynchronized: Go releases the install run heavy reservation after its task reports completion and refuses normal-class work while it is held; bridged calls first poll get_host_capacity until no reservation is held (only the settled count is observed, and the poll audit rows are excluded)
adapterPathsHit: none: no provider journey on either side shows a redirect, TLS, proxy or cancel-cause failure

declaredDivergences.D12.refused-callback-child-operation: the refused callback child operation row, isolated into its own query

openDivergences.unadmitted-callback-task-record: open divergence, pending owner decision; not Go parity
openDivergences.reject-null-provider-input-requests: open divergence, pending owner decision; not Go parity

sourceLock.interpretation: These two counts describe different projections. Complete parity is determined from the pinned source contracts plus actual tools/list for each supported mode and provider combination, not from either count alone.
sourceLock.runtimeAuthority: The live, authenticated, revisioned Host Agent catalog for the selected mode and active providers.

globalCutover: FAIL; candidate hash preserved, derived scenario items synced
